answer: Divergent Challenge Protocol. Each identity must answer a random live challenge whose correct response depends on its private history, so a clone that copied state still cannot produce a matching reply without the original's keys. Enforcement: mismatched answers void the identity and forfeit its escrowed timber holdings. An attacker cloning N identities must run N independent agents that wander through separate challenge streams, paying full compute and upkeep per copy. To reach any shared summit of influence, each clone must diverge on cue, which exposes the fork and collapses the whole set.
